initiatives.title: Enable authenticated runtime QA
initiatives.problem: Authenticated browser/CDP QA is unavailable for mobile and finance visual flows.
initiatives.user_impact: Reduces regression risk before product changes reach users.
initiatives.business_impact: Improves confidence for finance and mobile workflow releases.

initiatives.title: Finance workflow reliability pass
initiatives.problem: Finance remains the highest-impact operational module and should be hardened after runtime QA exists.
initiatives.user_impact: Reduces mistakes in payments, renewals and follow-up state changes.
initiatives.business_impact: Protects revenue tracking and operational trust.

initiatives.title: Dashboard decision usefulness
initiatives.problem: Dashboard can evolve from summary to daily action surface.
initiatives.user_impact: Helps professionals decide what to do first.

initiatives.title: Student experience continuity
initiatives.problem: Student-facing training continuity can be clearer around active workouts, history and next actions.
initiatives.user_impact: Improves comprehension and follow-through for students.

initiatives.title: Operational observability
initiatives.problem: Diagnostics can become more actionable for support without changing core workflows.

rationale: The recurring runtime limitation blocks full visual verification for authenticated mobile and finance flows. It is high leverage, isolated, and does not require reopening Product Audit v2 findings.
dependencies: clear distinction between environment blocked and functional failure
risks: Runtime setup may require credentials or environment coordination outside repository changes.
Finance visual QA remains partially static until authenticated runtime is available.
